summary: Inspected all 48 listed Lean files across HexECPPMathlib (19 files), HexPolyFast (7 files), and HexRationalFn (2 files). Every file contains formal mathematical declarations — theorems, lemmas, definitions, structures, instances, and proofs — relevant to elliptic curve primality proving (ECPP), fast polynomial arithmetic (half-GCD, cyclic/negacyclic convolution, multipoint evaluation, Padé approximation), and rational function normalization. The test files (LintTests.lean, Tests.lean, Tests/*.lean) contain actual `theorem` statements with kernel-checked proofs via `ecpp using`, not mere build-time regression checks. Policy.lean is a minimal compatibility re-export but has a public module docstring; under FILTER-007 it would only be excludable if the auxiliary navigation channel is verified deployed, which cannot be confirmed here. No file meets the FILTER-004 hard-exclusion bar.
